Invisible Mode — Toggle invisibility on or off through the GUI or by pressing G. Your character becomes partially transparent, with additional positioning behavior designed to make you harder to see..
No-Collide Feature — Disables local collision for other characters while invisibility is enabled.
Modern GUI — Clean design with smooth animations, toggle effects, and notifications.
Minimize & Restore — Minimize the GUI into a floating sphere and tap it to restore the main panel.
Draggable Interface — Move the main GUI and minimized sphere wherever you want.
Close Confirmation — Confirm before closing the GUI.
Respawn Handling — Resets the invisibility state when your character respawns.

What Does Alpha Mean?

Alpha means this script is an early development version. It may still have bugs, incomplete features, or unexpected behavior. More improvements, fixes, and changes may come in future updates.

How to Use:

1. Execute the script.
2. Press the toggle in the GUI or press G to activate/deactivate invisibility.
3. Stand up before enabling invisibility if your character is seated.
4. Minimize the GUI whenever you want a smaller interface.

Notice this script still Alpha A few Bugs may unexpectedly Appear.

	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1

local myRun = _G.AutoClickerRunId

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

	old:Destroy()

local function tycoonNameOfClicker(clicker: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return clicker.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function tycoonNameOfGiver(giver: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return giver.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function collectClickers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Clicker" then
			local model = d.Parent.Parent
			local mine = model and model.Parent
			if model and model.Name == "Model" and mine then
				table.insert(found, {
					clicker = d.Parent,
					detector = d,
					model = model,
					mine = mine,
					tycoon = tycoonNameOfClicker(d.Parent),
				})
				if #found >= 50 then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function collectGivers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Giver" and d:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
			table.insert(found, {
				part = d,
				tycoon = tycoonNameOfGiver(d),
			})
			if #found >= 50 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local entries = collectClickers()
local givers = collectGivers()

local KEYWORDS = { "click", "mine", "drop", "upgrade", "tycoon", "speed", "button", "ore" }

local function nameMatches(n: string): boolean
	local l = string.lower(n)
	for _, k in ipairs(KEYWORDS) do
		if string.find(l, k, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local allRemotes: any = {}
local seen: any = {}
local function addRemote(r: any)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and not seen[r] then
		seen[r] = true
		table.insert(allRemotes, r)
	end
end

local function scanRoot(root: any, cap: number, onlyMatching: boolean)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return root:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		n += 1
		if n > cap then
			break
		end
		if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			if not onlyMatching or nameMatches(d.Name) then
				addRemote(d)
			end
			if #allRemotes >= 25 then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

for _, e in ipairs(entries) do

	scanRoot(e.model, 100, false)

scanRoot(ReplicatedStorage, 2000, true)

statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
statusLabel.Text = "starting..."
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local enabled = false
local collectEnabled = false
local dragging = false
local dragStart = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local startPos = mainFrame.Position
local fires = 0
local collects = 0
local connections = {}

local function refreshStatus()
	local methodText = "NONE"
	if hasFireClick and #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = "fireclick+" .. tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	elseif hasFireClick then
		methodText = "fireclick"
	elseif #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	end
	local touchText = if hasFireTouch then "invisible" else "teleport"
	statusLabel.Text = "Clickers: " .. tostring(#entries) .. " | " .. methodText .. "\nMoneyGivers: " .. tostring(#givers) .. " (" .. touchText .. ") | Fires: " .. tostring(fires) .. " | Collects: " .. tostring(collects)
end
refreshStatus()

local function cleanup()
	enabled = false
	collectEnabled = false
	dragging = false
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	screenGui:Destroy()
	collectgarbage("collect")
end

table.insert(connections, dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 85)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, collectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	collectEnabled = not collectEnabled
	if collectEnabled then
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: ON"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)
	else
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, closeBtn.Activated:Connect(cleanup))

local function doCollectAll()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	if hasFireTouch then
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 0)
				task.wait()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 1)
			end)
		end
	else
		local saved: CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				hrp.CFrame = g.part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end)
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		pcall(function()
			hrp.CFrame = saved
		end)
	end
	collects += 1
	refreshStatus()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
		if collectEnabled and #givers > 0 then
			pcall(doCollectAll)
		end
		local waited = 0
		while waited < 5 and myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
			task.wait(0.1)
			waited += 0.1
		end
	end
end)

local hbConn
hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId then
		pcall(function()
			hbConn:Disconnect()
		end)
		return
	end
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	fires += 1
	if hasFireClick then
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			pcall(fireclickdetector, e.detector)
		end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
		pcall(function()
			r:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	if fires % 15 == 0 then
		refreshStatus()
	end
end)
table.insert(connections, hbConn)

local function applyPack(packName)
	if applying then return false end
	applying = true

	local pack = PACKS[packName]
	if not pack then
		warn("Unknown pack:", packName)
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local animate = waitForAnimate(char)
	if not animate then
		warn("Animate not found")
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	stopAllTracks(hum)

	local runObj   = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("run"),   "RunAnim")
	local walkObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("walk"),  "WalkAnim")
	local jumpObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("jump"),  "JumpAnim")
	local fallObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("fall"),  "FallAnim")
	local climbObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("climb"), "ClimbAnim")
	local swimObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swim"),     "Swim")
	local swimIdleObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swimidle"), "SwimIdle")
	local idleFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("idle")

	setAnim(walkObj,  pick(pack, "WalkAnim", "Walk"))
	setAnim(runObj,   pick(pack, "RunAnim", "Run"))
	setAnim(jumpObj,  pick(pack, "JumpAnim", "Jump"))
	setAnim(fallObj,  pick(pack, "FallAnim", "Fall"))
	setAnim(climbObj, pick(pack, "ClimbAnim", "Climb"))

	setAnim(swimObj,      pick(pack, "Swim"))
	setAnim(swimIdleObj,  pick(pack, "SwimIdle") or pick(pack, "Swim"))

	if idleFolder then
		local a1 = pick(pack, "Animation1")
		local a2 = pick(pack, "Animation2")

		if a1 or a2 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, 2)
			local id1 = a1 or a2
			local id2 = a2 or a1 or id1
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), id1)
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), id2)
		elseif pack.Idle and #pack.Idle > 0 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, math.max(2, #pack.Idle))
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), pack.Idle[1])
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), pack.Idle[2] or pack.Idle[1])
			for i = 3, #pack.Idle do
				local a = idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation" .. i)
				if a then setAnim(a, pack.Idle[i]) end
			end
		end
	end

	animate.Disabled = true
	task.wait(0.06)
	animate.Disabled = false

	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			task.wait(0.03)
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end)
	end

	pcall(function() player:SetAttribute(ATTR_LAST, packName) end)

	applying = false
	return true
end
